design_description: A rich purple, gold and white design built around sweeping asymmetric curves. The upper half stays predominantly solid purple, keeping the chest clean, while the graphic becomes progressively more expressive toward the lower torso. The main feature is a series of large flowing diagonal bands sweeping from one hip across the body. Gold is the dominant secondary colour, combined with purple negative space and a bold white section at the hem. Several thin gold strokes run alongside the larger shapes, giving the composition a sense of speed and movement without becoming aggressive or angular. The broad gold band contains a very subtle tone-on-tone repeating wave and scallop pattern, adding texture and detail when viewed closely while reading as solid gold from distance. Gold is repeated around the crew-neck collar and sleeve cuffs, neatly connecting the upper part of the jersey with the lower graphic. White is used sparingly, mainly as a strong accent within the sweeping lower section and for the player numbering. The back follows the same visual language: predominantly purple through the upper body, with the curved gold, purple and white bands wrapping naturally around the lower torso. The player name and large number sit cleanly in the open upper area. Overall, it is an elegant asymmetric three-colour design: deep purple provides the premium base, metallic-style gold gives it identity, and white adds contrast. The flowing curves make it feel dynamic while remaining much cleaner and more refined than a typical geometric or brush-stroke pattern.
